test_missing: {tool} is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
test_missing_project: {tool} is not a dependency of the project ({detail}). Add it to the component's devDependencies; the run installs the project's dependencies into its own volume and never into your folder.
test_no_target: No {file} was found in the component, so {tool} has nothing to run.
test_no_integration: No integration test matches the selection ({selection}) in the component, so the integration step does not apply here and runs nothing. Mark the integration tests that way or set tools.<id>.selection.
test_condition_executes: Runs the project's tests (executes project code); the result is self-reported and never cached.
test_condition_unit_excludes: The unit run leaves out the integration selection ({selection}), which runs in its own step: no test counts twice.
test_limitation_go-test: go test -json in the Go module of the component; statement coverage with -coverprofile; the modules must be in the dependency volume (the run is offline).
test_limitation_dotnet-test: dotnet test of the one solution or project of the component with the TRX logger; coverage needs coverlet.collector in the test project.
test_limitation_jest: The project's own Jest (a dev dependency installed by the deps phase) with the JSON results file; line coverage of the json-summary report.
test_no_invocation: The plan has no test invocation for the instance {tool}.
test_cancelled: The run was cancelled; {tool} was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
test_timeout: {tool} exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
test_exit_error: {tool} ended with code {code} without a test report JGates can read: {detail}
test_exit_mismatch: {tool} ended with code {code}, which its report does not explain ({failed, plural, one {# failing test} other {# failing tests}}): the result is not trusted. {detail}
test_cov_blocked_by_exit: Coverage was not measured: the test run gave no result JGates can trust.
test_cov_not_collected: {tool} did not measure coverage in this run.
test_cov_no_coverlet: The test project does not reference coverlet.collector, so dotnet test cannot measure coverage. Add the package to the test project (dotnet add package coverlet.collector); JGates never installs it.
test_cov_unreadable: The coverage report could not be read: {detail}
test_cov_empty: The coverage report has no measured line: nothing proves the coverage.
test_cov_below: Coverage of {component} is {percent}% ({covered} of {total}), below the minimum of {minimum}% ({source}).
test_cov_reason_nomin: Coverage {percent}% ({covered} of {total}), no minimum in the policy
test_integration_own_instance: The integration tests run in an instance of their own (capabilities: [integration]); this instance runs the unit tests and leaves them out. Move integration out of {tool}.
test_no_tests: {tool} ran no test: nothing proves this step (selection {selection}).
test_reason_tests: {tool} {version}: {executed, plural, one {# test} other {# tests}} executed, {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped
test_reason_integration: {tool} {version}, integration selection {selection}: {executed, plural, one {# test} other {# tests}} executed, {failed} failed, {skipped} skipped
test_reason_properties: {framework}: {total, plural, one {# property test} other {# property tests}} executed, {failed} failed
test_reason_no_properties: No property test ({framework}) among the tests that ran: the properties capability does not apply to this component.
